headline: Non-executive director acquires 50,000 units on market
summary: A non-executive director purchased 50,000 units at $2.18 per unit, increasing their total holding to 410,000 units. Routine director interest notice.

headline: $85m placement funds $120m Northshore Clinics acquisition
summary: Institutional placement at 9.5% discount to fund acquisition of 14 day-surgery clinics for $120m, with balance from debt. Expected EPS accretive in first full year of ownership.

headline: Pit wall failure cuts FY27 copper guidance, raises costs
summary: A pit wall failure closed the main haul road for ~8 weeks, reducing FY27 copper production guidance to 180-195kt and increasing AISC by 12% to A$4.85/lb. No injuries. Remediation underway.

headline: Half-year revenue up 31% to $48.2m, first positive operating cash flow
summary: Revenue grew strongly and ARR reached $112m. The company achieved its first positive operating cash flow. Full-year guidance remains unchanged, indicating confidence in the second half.

headline: CEO resigns effective 31 January 2027
summary: The CEO of six years is resigning to pursue other opportunities. The board is searching for a successor internally and externally. The CFO will serve as interim CEO if no successor is appointed by the effective date.

headline: All AGM resolutions passed on a poll
summary: Routine AGM outcome; all shareholder resolutions were passed. No material impact expected for investors.
